    FROM Entertainer_Styles

FirstStyles AS (

    FROM RankedStyles
    WHERE rn = 1

    FROM RankedStyles
    WHERE rn = 2

EntertainerPairs AS (

    FROM FirstStyles fs
    JOIN SecondStyles ss ON fs.EntertainerID = ss.EntertainerID

    FROM RankedPrefs
    WHERE rn = 1

    FROM RankedPrefs

CustomerPairs AS (
    SELECT fp.CustomerID, fp.FirstStyle, sp.SecondStyle
